answer: One enforceable rule: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its yarrow recurs, its trellis survives audit, and a canyon from an unlinked peer confirms it.
